title: Call Santa: Build a Santa Phone Line
summary: An elf walks you through building a Santa phone line for the kids in your life: your kids, grandkids, nieces, nephews or godkids. They call a real number and a jolly Santa knows their names, their good deeds and their dog's name. No code, nothing to install.
detail: Pick an elf guide, paste two free keys, and tell Santa about your family by talking it through with the elf. Pick the Christmas music he answers over, press one button, and the page builds your Santa in Vapi with Deepgram's jolly Cliff voice, a real recorded ho ho ho and a free phone number. After the kids call, Santa's Mailbag has every recording, transcript and wish list to keep.
outcome: A real phone number the kids in your life can call to reach Santa, plus the recording and wish list from every call.
prereqs: A free Deepgram account (console.deepgram.com) and an API key. It wakes up your elf and becomes Santa's ears and voice. New accounts get free credit.
A free Vapi account (dashboard.vapi.ai) and its Private API key. Vapi answers the phone and gives you a free number.
A laptop with a desktop browser and a microphone (headsets are provided in the room).
The kids’ first names, ages, a good deed or two from this year, and a few fun facts Santa can magically know.
artifact: A working Santa phone number, and a mailbag of call recordings and wish lists.

slides.title: Call Santa: a Santa phone line for the kids in your life
bullets: A real phone number that rings Santa at the North Pole
Your kids, grandkids, nieces, nephews: Santa knows their names, good deeds and wish lists
No code. An elf walks you through every step
slides.note: Welcome everyone. Tonight is the Phone Lab’s Christmas bonus. By the end, every grown-up here has a real phone number that the kids in their life can call to talk to Santa.

slides.title: By the end of tonight, you will have:
bullets: A real phone number the kids in your life can call, any time in December
A jolly, old-sounding Santa who greets each child by name
The nice list: Santa names their good deeds from this year
Funny nudges in your words (“be nicer to your sister, or… coal!”)
Christmas music under the call and a real “ho ho ho”
Santa’s Mailbag: every call’s recording, transcript and wish list
slides.note: Set expectations: this is a real phone line on the real phone network, not a demo. Everyone keeps it all December.

slides.title: Ears, brain, voice and a phone line
bullets: Vapi answers the phone and gives you a free number
Deepgram Flux is Santa’s ears: it hears the child and knows when they’re done talking
Claude, run by Vapi, is Santa’s brain, so there’s no extra AI account
Deepgram’s Cliff voice speaks, made jolly, then slower and deeper so he sounds like Santa
Your family details become Santa’s prompt
slides.note: This is the same stack as Week 1: a phone line, ears, a brain and a voice. The only new part is the Santa voice, which this site makes older and adds the real recorded laugh to.

slides.title: Jingle or Twinkle will guide you
bullets: Two elves, both Deepgram voices played 25% faster so they sound tiny
Talk to your elf: it asks about your family and fills in the form for you
It plays the music choices and answers questions when you’re stuck
Your elf runs on your own Deepgram key
slides.note: The elf is a Deepgram Voice Agent. The squeaky elf sound is the same trick as Santa’s, in reverse: play the voice faster and it gets higher.

slides.title: Two free accounts and a few family facts
bullets: Deepgram: console.deepgram.com → API Keys → Create key (free credit included)
Vapi: dashboard.vapi.ai → API Keys → copy the PRIVATE key
Each child’s first name and age, one or two good deeds, and their wish list
Little things Santa can “magically” know: a lost tooth, a pet’s name
A headset or quiet corner to talk to your elf
slides.note: The only time anyone goes to the Vapi website is to copy that key. The lesson page sets up everything else. Remind people: Private key, not Public.

slides.title: Santa’s rules, built in
bullets: First names only: no addresses, schools or last names
Santa never promises a gift. He’ll “talk to the elves”
Nobody is ever naughty. Coal is only a joke, and only if you ask for it
If a child sounds sad or unsafe, Santa gently sends them to a grown-up
Keys and family details aren’t stored on this site. Recordings live in your own Vapi account
slides.note: Point out these rules are locked into every Santa. Grown-ups can add funny nudges, but Santa always ends by saying they’re on the nice list.

slides.title: Call your Santa
bullets: Call your new number from your phone and say the child’s name
Listen for the music, the jolly voice and the real “ho ho ho”
Change anything on the page, then press Update my Santa
Open Santa’s Mailbag to hear the recording and see the wish list
slides.note: Everyone calls their own Santa. Walk the room and help anyone whose new number isn’t ringing yet (it can take a few minutes).

slides.title: Keep every call
bullets: Every call shows the date, who called and what they wished for
Press Download to save a recording, or Download all
Vapi only keeps recordings for a while, so save the ones you love
Come back any time in December: paste your Vapi key and open the mailbag
slides.note: These recordings are going to be family treasures. Strongly encourage people to download them before Vapi’s retention runs out.

slides.title: Your agent is yours: change it in Vapi
bullets: Go to dashboard.vapi.ai and sign in
Click Assistants in the left menu
Open “Santa (dgeventhub)”
Everything Santa says comes from the System Prompt in the Model section
slides.note: Now take them into the Vapi dashboard live. Show the Assistants list and open the Santa assistant.

slides.title: Turn Santa into someone new
bullets: In Model → System Prompt, replace Santa’s instructions with your new character
Change First Message to how the new character answers the phone
Change the Voice: pick Deepgram, then any Aura-2 or Flux voice
Set Background Sound to Off, or paste a link to new music
Press Publish. The same phone number now rings your new character
slides.note: Do it live: paste a short Tooth Fairy or birthday prompt, publish, and call the number. Note: pressing Update my Santa on the lesson page later puts Santa back.

slides.title: Same number, new magic
bullets: The Tooth Fairy, on call for the next wobbly tooth
A birthday call from their favorite character
A bedtime-story line, or the Easter Bunny in spring
A homework buddy who quizzes spelling words
Or remove the number under Phone Numbers when you’re done
slides.note: Encourage reuse. Everything from Week 1 to 3 applies: tools, testing, breaking it.

slides.title: Merry Christmas from the Phone Lab
bullets: You built a real voice agent on a real phone number
Share how the calls go, and add the cutest to the playlist!
Keep your keys private, and rotate them after the holidays
slides.note: Close the lab. Thank cohosts. Ask people to share (with permission) their favorite kid moments.

flow.title: Build your Santa with your elf
flow.note: Seven steps on one page: pick an elf, paste your Deepgram and Vapi keys, tell Santa about your family, pick the music, make your Santa, call him, then open Santa’s Mailbag.

flow.title: Call Santa, and change him after Christmas

troubleshooting: Connect fails: use the Private key from Vapi (API Keys), not the Public key, and copy the Deepgram key again without spaces.
Make my Santa is greyed out: connect both keys, add at least one child's first name, and choose the music.

No phone number: Vapi gives each account one free number. Give Santa your current Vapi number (the button on the page; it stops answering for your other agent), delete an old number in Vapi under Phone Numbers and press Update my Santa, or sign up for Vapi with another Google account and use its Private key.
A new number does not ring yet: free numbers can take a few minutes to activate. Press Check my number.
The elf will not talk: check the Deepgram key, allow the microphone in the address bar, and press Wake up again.
No wish list in the mailbag: it appears about a minute after the call ends. Press Check for new calls.
Recordings are kept by Vapi for a limited time. Download the ones you love.
